use default
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo

isqrt(x: bigint) -> bigint is
    let two = 2n
    let four = 4n
    let q mut = 1n

    while q <= x do
        q = q * four
    od

    let z mut = x
    let root mut = 0n

    while q > 1n do
        q = q / four

        let remainder = z - root - q

        root = root / two

        if remainder >= 0n then
            z = remainder
            root = root + q
        fi
    od

    return root
si

grouped(value: bigint) -> string =>
    value.to_string("N0", CultureInfo.invariant_culture)

write_line("isqrt of 0 through 65:")

let roots = LIST()

for n in 0::65 do
    roots.add("{isqrt(cast(n))}")
od

write_line(roots |> join(" "))

write_line("")
write_line("isqrt of the odd powers of 7 from 7^1 to 7^73:")

let seven = 7n

(1::73)
    |> filter(power => power % 2 == 1)
    |> each(power =>
        write_line(
            "7^{power,-2} {grouped(isqrt(bigint.pow(seven, power)))}"))
